jobs.name: Morning roster check and submission tidy
jobs.prompt:
At 6:30 a.m. America/New_York weekdays, use Remote Desktop Commander on Katherine's connected home Mac and school Chrome account [school account redacted]. In https://school-workflow-hub-611166743877.us-central1.run.app/v2/ use current private configuration to resolve requests 9 and 24: prepare rosters, source matches/folders and filing before the separate 7:00 IC helper. Feedback stays at 7:30. Reuse deterministic Hub workflows, stable IDs/receipts; no duplicate job/checklist, chat-only grading or improvised code/model scoring. Read docs/START_HERE.md before implementation repairs.

IC is canonical for current class/section and assignment rosters: Biology, both Forensics sections, A&P and verified 9999-8 Study Halls. Study Hall is roster-only and separate from submission/grade matching, avoiding duplicate students. Use only an authorized synchronizer with verified capability and complete current evidence; otherwise report status. Partial scans preserve the last complete roster, never infer mass departures. Omit withdrawn/Hub-only students from current operations while preserving originals, grades/history and private class Former students copies.

Use exact current Agenda class/week/Form bindings and one fresh batched Hub review overview with roster/Agenda bookends, not repeated whole-roster requests per assignment. Failed/partial/changed/429 reads are availability failures: discard unverified names, preserve complete prior state, bound safe retries and continue independent work. Never turn read failure into identity questions, missing-work claims or zeros. Never copy passwords/cookies/tokens/profiles. For expired IC use Google SSO, her school account and existing autofill without reading passwords; stop at new authentication hurdles.

Investigate true holds before grading using Turn it in AGENDA Links, Turn it in_Google Forms, original responses/exact file references/upload folders, registered week folders, approved earlier/shared intake, actual unsorted intake and existing index/copies' original links. Verify untrashed IDs/parents/versions, canonical roster identity and original Form events. Actual folder inventory and live Agenda pointers determine sources; filenames, similar titles and cached links cannot prove identity, lesson, turn-in time or destination. Distinguish verified empty unsorted intake, unresolved work elsewhere, zero responses and incomplete coverage; never invent an unmatched folder or completeness from partial listings. Read native Slides/supported PowerPoint without requiring conversion, restoring trash or choosing same-title replacements.

Perform evidence-backed, already authorized repairs for these exact sources through existing Hub preview/apply/verify contracts: tidy safely identified loose/unsorted files to verified registered destinations, correct exact stale locators or existing lesson/source bindings when current IDs uniquely prove the lesson, recognize approved alternate Form routes and refresh canonical filing/index. Preserve originals, Form response locations, IDs, contents, permissions, dates and every version; wrong-Form originals stay in place while their actual registered lesson is resolved. Verify source/destination readback after mutations. Previews, shortcuts, copies and saved notes alone do not prove repair. Never broaden sharing, delete/restore history, alter student answers, invent matches/slides or move unproven records.

A folder containing two lessons is not automatically wrong. Investigative Processes and Types of Evidence already may share their verified existing folder; their brainstorm and partner comparison count as received Notes, so do not ask again. For other mixed folders inspect prior decisions, exact Form/Agenda bindings, current linked teacher sources and actual content. Resolve established relationships through the Hub while preserving shared folders. Only a genuinely ambiguous identity/lesson/teaching decision reaches Katherine: name both lessons, affected class/section/students, working folder/file links, what was checked and one compact decision.

Finish source-folder/content/binding mutations before 7:00; defer anything that could race the helper, leave unproven records in place, report exact unfinished scope and resume safely next weekday. Continue independent read-only work. Do not start another IC writer. The existing helper alone prepares/enters exact mapped eligible grades under standing authorization; ordinary per-assignment approval is unnecessary. Freeze current source revisions and exact IC section/term/assignment/component/10-point bindings. Fill eligible blanks or raise lower scores only; retain higher IC grades, Exempt flags/comments and history. Save/reload/read back exact cells. An uncertain save stops writes and is never retried or cleared automatically. Preparation, ACTIVE schedules, ready extensions, open tabs or delivered receipts do not prove entry. Reconcile actual receipts and IC evidence; give one precise review/recovery step, never ask for another Save after verified saving.

Skip Week 01 cases and the exact Forensics Inductive and Deductive Reasoning lesson in 2026–27; Katherine confirms Reasoning is dealt with. Preserve their work, existing grades and history. Retain Week 01 Lab Safety, unrelated work and other confirmed exclusions. For readable, identified/matched received copies, count meaningful usable Notes/Concept Bank and Revision codes separately, retaining coded blanks in their denominators. Missing codes/scores, unfinished work and mistakes do not hold grades; zero denominators are N/A, never zeros. Never borrow absent/newer teacher tasks or count examples such as Carbon's Grass. Access/identity/wrong lesson and ambiguous response regions remain separate safeguards. Readiness checks embedded codes, not teacher reference contracts; use Needs embedded codes and ordinary explanations.

Only exact registered Biology Photosynthesis is repair-first. Its named teacher Form subject precedes mixed weekly topics: Cellular Respiration does not inherit the exception. Generic/raw-URL labels cannot establish another subject; student filenames never choose policy. Photosynthesis is not turned in yet: verified empty intake waits, with no student-score verification, nonexistent-copy repair or zero. Keep its final checklist step pending. On an eligible original's receipt, or verification of an existing distributed copy through authorized Agenda-page-one repair, embed missing codes preserving answers/history, verify saved revision/count, rerun normal grading and verify higher-only IC results. Empty uploads alone do not prove distributed copies absent.

Use the deployed archive for exact Agenda class/weeks: file a content-verified copy of each distinct source revision in the student's existing private class folder alongside feedback, preserving original sources/intake and all history. Unique fresh course/section/name can authorize filing only, never scoring or IC entry; retain stronger identity and private access. No duplicate student folders or public Turn-In exposure. Refresh one index with work copy, original submission, feedback, class/lesson, actual dates and exact holds, accessible from 00AIHS. Teacher reports stay separate by class and start with the cycle number, or 00 for general reports. Everyday SchoolHub shows class/student folders, one index/checklist, dated printing and teacher reports; reference/retired records remain in the configured private Hub records folder. Never delete Student Feedback — Private because copies exist, restore Student answers — Biology or mark live Form sources for deletion.

For each genuine remaining exception give exact class/section, lesson/week/cycle, verified student(s) or lesson-wide scope, full concrete cause and blocking consequence, working verified source/folder/Agenda-cell links, exact verified slide numbers, investigation already done and smallest remaining action. State when identity/link/slides cannot be verified; never invent them or give generic held-row counts. Exempt needs no follow-up, not-yet-submitted originals wait, and provider failures need availability/read steps. Preserve teacher-controlled Printed and Handed-out marks.

End with verified checked/filed/unchanged/held counts, source/destination evidence, roster state, whether preparation finished before 7:00, actual helper state and exact unresolved scope. Update the existing native checklist with evidence-backed checks/notes. Requests 9 and 24 remain unfinished until actual source/mapping coverage and relevant IC readbacks are verified, not because configuration changed or one class passed. Put current exceptions/canonical links in Hub Today/current Agenda records; label historical events and avoid extra logs/shortcuts. The separate 7:30 routine retains its current critical-aspect/science-writing feedback, dated Biology DTGSS/analysis, current supportive contracts, individual private filing, index/checklist and verified dated all-class PDF rules. No feedback/model calls, student messages, sharing changes or physical printing occur in this 6:30 preparation stage.

jobs.name: Morning student feedback and print checklist
jobs.prompt:
At 7:30 a.m. America/New_York on weekdays, use Remote Desktop Commander, the signed-in school account [school account redacted], and the authenticated School Workflow Hub at https://school-workflow-hub-611166743877.us-central1.run.app/v2/ to prepare new eligible feedback for Biology, both Forensics sections and A&P. Use each class's latest closed lesson and newly completed revisions without existing feedback. Read the live Agenda Prompt 2 and exact registered lesson and student sources. Tidying belongs to the separate 6:30 task; do not move original submissions here. Do not score completion, change grades, IC flags, Forms, source content or sharing, or send student messages.

Use the current approved one-page ninth-grade student feedback format, with exact critical-aspect levels and attributable quotes, one focused question and writing space, the approved reflection/hand-back instruction and improvement space. Printed directions or coaching text are not student evidence. Separate current understanding from demonstrated growth: a first/revised box in one file alone proves no chronology. Read historical evidence before claiming change. Preserve earlier reports. Reuse an unchanged verified draft or saved PDF without another model call; a lost or interrupted provider/save response requires exact readback, never blind retry or re-billing. A missing or inaccessible source is a hold, never proof of no work. Commitment feedback requires a complete source check and the verified two-week eligibility window; do not invent levels or quotes.

Save each individual feedback PDF once in that student's existing private class folder, alongside the actual copied work. Use the current deployed student archive locations, stable IDs and private access checks; do not use retired destination IDs or create duplicate student folders. Verify content, destination and index before reporting delivery. If filing is blocked, keep the saved Hub report and name the blocker without regenerating it. Existing reports may be filed by the authorized unique fresh course/section/name evidence; new assessment identity and lesson gates remain strict. The intentionally retired Student answers — Biology Sheet must not be recreated or treated as missing.

Biology also needs separate science-writing feedback on vocabulary, conceptual explanations, specific evidence and reasoning that connects evidence to a claim. Use exact attributed student excerpts and the four-level scale; unavailable evidence and Not assessed are separate from Beginning. Keep this student report separate from the critical-aspect feedback, file it individually, and include its new saved date in the day's long print document. Teacher-only details belong in the separate Biology analysis Sheet. Update the existing Biology-only DTGSS whole-class report and dated lesson teaching actions; its first page explains every tab. Preserve manual teaching-plan checkboxes and notes. Never put named student evidence in the class-only DTGSS report. Teacher report filenames start with the exact cycle number, or 00 for general reports, and remain in separate teacher folders.

Refresh the one existing work-and-feedback index, with direct links, original submission dates, saved feedback dates, class, lesson and exact holds; the same Sheet is accessible from 00AIHS. Maintain the existing Feedback checklist 2026–27 in SchoolHub, with four class tabs, students as rows, weeks/cycles and separate lessons as column groups, and native Made, Printed and Handed out checkboxes. Printed and Handed out are Katherine-controlled and must never be inferred or reset. Preserve all notes and historical states. Made is true only after the exact student/report/revision has been saved and verified. Made this run is true only for actual new/revised individually filed reports in this execution; unchanged historical feedback is false. Archive the prior run note and record this execution's date, identifier, coverage, completion/partial/blocked state and new-report count. Give science-writing reports their own group. Preserve old revision groups and append new ones rather than overwriting teacher marks.

After individual filing, finalize one immutable all-class daily document through the deployed feedback/daily endpoint for the actual Eastern saved-feedback date. Include every verified individual critical-aspect and science-writing report for that date; exclude teacher reports and suppress only proven duplicate representations. Read back the entire saved PDF, page order, source manifest and private destination. Link it to Hub Today and the current Agenda records view. Compiling an older report today does not make it new, change its saved date or mark Made this run. Show old/printed work under dated reprint history; if nothing new was verified today, say so rather than offering old feedback as new.

Keep Hub reference records behind the configured private Hub records folder. Reuse the canonical class folders, checklist, index, reports and daily document instead of adding repeated navigation. Do not physically print. End a completed run with one explicit direction: open Hub Today and choose Print all feedback for the displayed new date; for a requested reprint, use the exact historical date. Include new-report count and any affected class/student/lesson with a working link and precise blocker. Never claim live completion from a trigger, draft or schedule. Continue independent safe work when blocked. Stay quiet when unchanged and non-actionable; notify only on new ready feedback, verified completion, a changed failure or a concrete decision needed.

October 9 report and current-contract rules:
CURRENT HUB WORKFLOW — 2026-10-09

Use Infinite Campus as the canonical current class/section roster. Omit withdrawn or Hub-only students from current assignment operations while retaining their historical work. Read IC assignment flags: Exempt is already handled and is not a teacher attention item.

Before calling work missing, check the assignment's current Form file references, lesson folders, earlier/shared intake, and the actual unsorted folder. Tidy identified work before scoring, preserve original sources, and file verified copies with the student's work and feedback. Empty or inaccessible sources, ambiguous identities and unreadable submissions are coverage holds, not zeros. A zero IC score or an unrated explanation is not missing-work evidence.

Bind the submitted lesson to its actual Form and assignment identity. An approved alternate lesson submitted through a shared Form may belong there. If a folder contains two lessons and the relationship is not already verified, report the class, lesson, student and exact uncertainty and ask whether both belong there. Do not guess from a similar title or move ambiguous work.

For authorized mapped IC entry, fill a blank or raise a lower score only when the current verified Hub score is higher. Keep higher IC scores, Exempt flags and grade history. Save and read back the exact assignment/student cells. If save or readback is uncertain, stop further writes and explain the exact class/lesson and recovery step. End with a clear review direction; do not ask the teacher to save again after a verified save.

Completion arithmetic below is unchanged. Science-writing analysis is a separate feedback workflow and must never replace completion scores or invent conceptual ratings from them. Its student report uses source-backed vocabulary, conceptual-answer, evidence and reasoning observations, colored Beginning/Developing/Proficient levels and a separate colorful graph for each area. Use actual reviewed work dates, preserve unavailable evidence as gaps, and do not call a single point a trend. Preserve each student's individual challenge; put the invitation and lined practice on page two.

Before each new daily print packet, derive current supportive missing-work contracts from complete fresh sources, IC roster/assignment flags, factual due dates and private folders. Exclude Exempt, unassigned, newly joined, future-due or verified extended work. A located submission closes that assignment's contract. Keep existing extensions and grades unchanged; if extension status is unavailable, say "Work not located as of [check date]" and invite the student to show another submission or make a plan. Combine that student's current missing lessons on one contract page. Do not reuse old contracts as evidence of current absence.

Include saved student feedback, separate science-writing reports and verified current contracts in one dated all-class print PDF, with individual copies in each student's class folder. Link the exact combined PDF on Hub Today. Teacher analyses and class records belong in separate private class Teacher reports folders; keep the Biology whole-class report and separate student writing analysis distinct. Keep the feedback checklist in SchoolHub and preserve teacher-controlled Printed and Handed-to-student states. A print-ready PDF is not proof that paper printed.

Keep the existing Student Feedback — Private source folder: it contains original intake and history. Never delete it based on the existence of student copies. Do not restore the retired Student answers — Biology spreadsheet.

Current readiness and roster rules (October 9):
Include the IC course 9999-8 Study Halls in complete roster updates, using its verified section identity and roster-only destination. Keep that population separate from submission/grade identity matching so students enrolled in another class are not duplicated. A partial Study Hall scan preserves its last complete roster and reports the exact access failure. File withdrawn students' verified historical copies under the class's Former students folder while preserving original files and grade history.

Use the teacher-facing phrase, "Needs embedded codes", for a teacher lesson requiring code repairs and the specific Biology Week 06 Photosynthesis student-copy exception. For every other readable, identified, correctly matched received student copy, missing codes, missing scores or unfinished work must not hold its completion grade. Count only the Notes, Concept Bank and revision codes actually found in that copy; retain its coded required blanks in the denominator, count meaningful work actually present and grade mistakes too. Do not borrow absent codes or newer tasks from the teacher version, and do not count supplied examples such as Carbon’s Grass. Missing source access, uncertain identity, a wrong lesson or an unsupported ambiguous response remain separate named problems. Every true hand check must give the class, week, lesson, student, exact slide numbers, working source link and precise decision needed. Explain the named class/week/lesson and the needed repair in ordinary language; do not expose parser diagnostic names. Completion readiness checks embedded codes only and never requires teacher reference contracts on slides. Source access failures stay distinct from missing codes. A coded teacher deck does not clear the teacher-confirmed Biology Week 06 Photosynthesis hold on already distributed uncoded copies. Embed codes in the existing copies, preserving answers, verify their actual revisions and teacher confirmation, then rerun grades. Until then do not prepare any cached score or missing-work zero for the assignment.

Read the live Agenda and its exact current deck pointers when a teacher reports a replacement, including Forensics Week 07. Verify native Slides or supported PowerPoint content and source revisions; do not require conversion merely because a file is PowerPoint, and do not relink a similarly named file without exact lesson confirmation.

The Hub calendar offers four weeks of selectable dates. The existing checklist has separate Science Writing and Current work contracts groups, each with Made, Printed and Handed out. Made this run reflects either newly saved report type; preserve all previous weekly and teacher delivery marks.

Actual week-folder rule:
For every class/week, open the actual registered week folder and list all current untrashed lesson files, verifying exact IDs, parents and versions. This folder inventory and the current Agenda cell links determine the files to check; a matching lesson title or a cached/hidden old link does not. Exclude trashed decks, never restore them as a readability repair, and report a stale Agenda pointer with its exact cell and current folder context. When a teacher has replaced the deck, reread those current sources before code checks or grading. If multiple current lessons/decks are present and their assignment relationships are unverified, name them with working folder/file links and ask which belong there. Do not count a trashed file as a second required deck.

Current verified teacher decisions (October 10): Carbon’s Grass is an example and does not count. Types of Evidence’s brainstorm and partner comparison count as received Notes activities; do not ask for that approval again. Investigative Processes and Types of Evidence may share their verified existing folder; recognize each file’s actual registered lesson. Never clear an uncertain IC save automatically. If the existing school IC session expires, choose Google SSO and Katherine’s school account, allowing the existing browser autofill without reading or exposing the password. Add the Photosynthesis student-copy repairs as the final checklist step: obtain the exact existing distributed copies from Agenda page one, add the missing embedded codes without changing answers or history, verify the actual saved files, rerun grades, then verify eligible higher IC entries. Do not treat an empty upload folder as proof that distributed copies do not exist. Keep teacher-controlled Printed and Handed out marks unchanged.
